2607.00491.title: MindEdit-Bench: Benchmarking Object-Level Counterfactual Spatial Reasoning in VLMs from In-the-Wild Photos
2607.00491.paper_summary: Benchmarks for vision-language models (VLMs) mostly test observational spatial reasoning: models describe relations already visible in the input. Existing what-if tasks typically vary the observer while keeping the scene fixed. Can VLMs instead predict the consequences of hypothetically moving or rotating an object? We introduce MindEdit-Bench, a benchmark of six spatial reasoning tasks built from three-photo smartphone triplets of newly captured indoor scenes via an automatic in-the-wild 3D scene-graph extraction pipeline. Four tasks probe perception and perspective transformation over observed structure; two new tasks, L4 (spatial editing) and L5 (cross-view visibility editing), probe object-level counterfactual reasoning, where correct answers are absent from all input images. Each question provides 8-24 structured answer choices, enabling answer-letter-level diagnosis of spatial and fallback errors. The benchmark covers 120 private indoor scenes not drawn from public datasets, reducing public-data pretraining-overlap risk. Across 15 VLMs on 1,003 human-verified questions, task-wise mean VLM accuracy is only 8%-31%, versus 81%-97% human majority-vote accuracy. The pooled human--best-VLM gap is 53 pp, with at least 39 pp on every task. The structured answer space further reveals non-uniform failures, including weaker camera-depth-axis inference and fallback behavior on difficult visibility-editing cases.
2607.00491.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言模型（VLMs）的基準主要測試觀察性空間推理：模型描述輸入中已經可見的關係。現有的假設性任務通常在保持場景固定的情況下變化觀察者。VLMs 能否預測假設性移動或旋轉物體的後果？我們介紹了 MindEdit-Bench，一個基於三張照片的智能手機三元組的新捕獲室內場景的六個空間推理任務基準，這些場景通過自動的野外 3D 場景圖提取管道構建而成。四個任務探查觀察結構的感知和視角轉換；兩個新任務，L4（空間編輯）和 L5（跨視圖可見性編輯），探查物體級的反事實推理，其中正確答案在所有輸入圖像中都不存在。每個問題提供 8-24 個結構化答案選擇，使得可以在答案字母級別上診斷空間和回退錯誤。該基準涵蓋了 120 個未從公共數據集中提取的私有室內場景，降低了公共數據預訓練重疊的風險。在 1,003 個經人類驗證的問題上，15 個 VLM 的任務平均準確率僅為 8%-31%，而人類多數投票的準確率為 81%-97%。人類與最佳 VLM 的差距為 53 個百分點，每個任務至少為 39 個百分點。結構化答案空間進一步揭示了不均勻的失敗，包括在困難的可見性編輯案例中較弱的相機深度軸推理和回退行為。
